paragraphs: A modern, production-ready CodeIgniter 4.6.3 starter kit designed for building secure, scalable, enterprise-grade web applications. Includes a robust authentication system powered by CodeIgniter Shield, a permission-aware sidebar menu system, a clean Bootstrap-based UI, reusable backend helpers, DataTables integration, and a developer-friendly structure ready for real business applications.
This project serves as a solid foundation for ERP systems, admin dashboards, internal business platforms, and modular multi-feature applications.
features: Reusable BaseModel, traits, helpers, and service extensions
Cache-buster helper for automatic asset versioning
